scripts.start:dev: pnpm run docker:start && cross-env NODE_ENV=development nest start --watch
scripts.start:debug: pnpm run docker:start && cross-env NODE_ENV=development nest start --debug --watch
scripts.test: pnpm run docker:start && cross-env NODE_ENV=development vitest run
scripts.test:watch: pnpm run docker:start && cross-env NODE_ENV=development vitest
scripts.test:cov: pnpm run docker:start && cross-env NODE_ENV=development vitest run --coverage
scripts.test:debug: pnpm run docker:start && cross-env NODE_ENV=development vitest --inspect-brk --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run docker:start && cross-env NODE_ENV=development vitest run --config ./vitest.config.e2e.ts
